headline: LLMjacking attacks rack up over $1 million in fraudulent cloud AI charges
summary: Attackers hijacking access to large language models, known as LLMjacking, are generating large fraudulent cloud AI charges. Google reports the attacks have racked up $1 million in cloud AI charges, with some organizations losing more than $100,000 per day to stolen LLM access.
